description: Frontend integration: wire the three new backend endpoints (FEAT-001/002/003) into the existing Riders Management admin module, plus a local production build check. Adds a new ridersApi.js client module and populates the RiderDetailsDrawer with completed-rides count, total spending (MRU), paginated ride history, ratings & reviews, payment + refund history, last login, last seen / account activity, and rider-filtered audit log — each with explicit loading/error/empty states and N/A for null. Keeps ALL existing search/filters/pagination/verification/account-management behavior intact (do not regress commits 176800fd/a597fa2e). DEPENDS ON FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003 (their endpoints must exist). Grounded in: frontend/src/admin/riders/{RidersManagement,RiderDetailsDrawer,ridersSelectors}.js, frontend/src/delivery/DeliveryShared.js apiRequest, frontend/src/apiConfig.js API_URL, frontend/src/security/securityApi.js getAuditLogs pattern.
steps: Create frontend/src/admin/riders/ridersApi.js exporting getRiderRideHistory(riderId, params), getRiderPayments(riderId, params), getRiderActivity(riderId), getRiderAuditLogs(riderId, params). Use `import { API_URL } from '../../apiConfig'` and `import { apiRequest } from '../../delivery/DeliveryShared'`. Build query strings with URLSearchParams. getRiderAuditLogs calls `${API_URL}/security/admin/audit-logs/?entity_type=customer&entity_id=${riderId}` (+ any extra params). Do NOT hardcode base URLs or auth headers; do NOT modify apiConfig.js.

In frontend/src/admin/riders/RiderDetailsDrawer.js, on drawer open (useEffect keyed on open+rider.id) fetch ride history (first page + summary), payments+refunds, activity, and the rider-filtered audit log via ridersApi.js. Hold per-section {loading, error, data} state. Render NEW sections for: Statistics (completed rides count + total spending MRU + average fare, from the summary), Ride history (paginated table: pickup/destination, driver, status, fare MRU, payment status, created/completed timestamps), Ratings & reviews (rating/review and driver_rating/driver_review per ride), Payment & refund history, Last login + Last seen / account activity, and Account activity (audit log). Every section shows an explicit loading state, an error state on a failed fetch, and an empty state when there are no records. Render N/A for any null field. Never fabricate values.

Replace the email-match heuristic as the AUTHORITATIVE source for completed rides / spending: prefer the summary from getRiderRideHistory; keep getCompletedRideCount only as a graceful fallback if the summary fetch fails (or remove its use in the drawer) — document the choice in a comment. Do not delete ridersSelectors exports still used by RidersManagement list rendering.

Thread any required props through frontend/src/admin/riders/RidersManagement.js only if needed (e.g. passing riderId to the drawer). Keep all existing props and behavior: search, verification/account/phone three-way status, client filters, list pagination, verification approve/reject, account block/unblock/delete.
Add additive styles for the new drawer sections in frontend/src/admin/riders/riders.css (do not restyle existing elements).

Add/extend frontend tests: create frontend/src/admin/riders/__tests__/RiderDetailsDrawer.test.js (and/or extend RidersManagement.test.js) using jest.mock('../ridersApi') following the existing RTL mock pattern. Cover: loading -> loaded rendering of history/payments/activity sections; N/A rendering for null fields; error-state rendering when a mocked fetch rejects; and that no sensitive payment field (provider_token / full card) is displayed.
Run the full admin frontend test suite and a local production build; record actual results.
acceptance_criteria: A new ridersApi.js module calls the three endpoints using API_URL + apiRequest (no hardcoded URLs/headers; apiConfig.js unchanged).

RiderDetailsDrawer shows completed rides, total spending (MRU), paginated ride history, ratings & reviews, payment + refund history, last login, last seen / account activity, and rider-filtered audit log, each with loading/error/empty states and N/A for null.

All existing Riders Management behavior (search, filters, pagination, verification approve/reject, account block/unblock/delete, status dimensions) still works; the committed redesign is not regressed.
`cd frontend; CI=true npm test -- --watchAll=false src/admin/riders` passes (existing + new tests).
`cd frontend; CI=true npm test -- --watchAll=false` passes for the admin dashboard and `cd frontend; npm run build` completes without errors.
verification: cd frontend; CI=true npm test -- --watchAll=false src/admin/riders
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Frontend integration of FEAT-001/002/003 into the existing Riders Management module. No existing behavior regressed; apiConfig.js untouched; no mobile apps or release/deploy snapshots touched.

FILES:
- NEW frontend/src/admin/riders/ridersApi.js: exports getRiderRideHistory(riderId, params), getRiderPayments(riderId, params), getRiderActivity(riderId), getRiderAuditLogs(riderId, params). Uses `import { API_URL } from '../../apiConfig'` + `import { apiRequest } from '../../delivery/DeliveryShared'`; query strings built with URLSearchParams (null/undefined/'' dropped). getRiderAuditLogs hits /security/admin/audit-logs/?entity_type=customer&entity_id=<id> (+extra params). No hardcoded base URLs or auth headers.
- MODIFIED frontend/src/admin/riders/RiderDetailsDrawer.js: on open (useEffect keyed on open+rider.id) fetches ride history (page 1, page_size 25) + summary, payments+refunds, activity, and the rider-filtered audit log. Per-section {loading,error,data} state. NEW sections: Statistics (total/completed/cancelled counts, total spending MRU, average fare), Ride history (paginated table: pickup/destination, driver name+email, status, fare MRU, payment status, created/completed), Ratings & reviews (per-ride rating/review + driver_rating/driver_review), Payment history, Refund history, Last login & activity (last_login/last_seen/last_seen_device), Account activity (audit log). Each section shows explicit loading/error/empty states; null fields render N/A; MRU amounts render via a local formatter that shows N/A for null (never coerces to 0).
- MODIFIED frontend/src/admin/riders/riders.css: additive styles only (.riders-detail__error, __table-wrap, __table, __pager, __reviews, __activity). No existing selector restyled.
- MODIFIED frontend/src/admin/riders/__tests__/RiderDetailsDrawer.test.js: jest.mock('../ridersApi'); covers fetch-on-open with rider id, statistics from the authoritative summary, history rows + driver info, N/A for null ride fields, payment/refund rendering, last login/seen/device, audit log entries, error states (history + payments rejection), empty states for all sections (incl. null total_spend -> N/A), and that a leaked provider_token/card number is NEVER rendered.
- MODIFIED frontend/src/admin/riders/__tests__/RidersManagement.test.js: added jest.mock('../ridersApi') + beforeEach resolved values (CRA resetMocks clears impls between tests) so the existing drawer-open tests still pass with the drawer now fetching.

AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE CHANGE: completed-rides count + spending now come from the backend `summary` (getRiderRideHistory). The old email-match heuristic (ridersSelectors.getCompletedRideCount) is kept ONLY as a documented graceful fallback for the completed-count display when the summary fetch fails; it never drives spending. getCompletedRideCount is still exported and still used by RidersManagement's list column, so no selector exports were removed.

PROPS: no threading needed — RidersManagement already passes rider/open/rides/getFileUrl to the drawer, and rider.id is available. All existing list behavior (search, verification/account filters, pagination, approve/reject, suspend/reactivate with confirmation, delete) is unchanged.

VERIFICATION (actual results):
- `admin/riders` suite: 3 suites, 48 tests, ALL PASS (ridersSelectors + RidersManagement + RiderDetailsDrawer).
- Full frontend suite: 88 passed / 13 failed suites (977 passed / 29 failed / 6 skipped tests). All 13 failing suites are PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to this task (src/App.test.js, auth/roleRouting, auth/sessionRestore, driver/DriverEarnings, and several rider/* suites failing on `estimateFare is not a function`, `joinRideGroup is not a function`, timeouts, etc.). Verified pre-existing by stashing the admin/riders changes and re-running a representative subset (App.test.js, rider/RideHistory.test.js, auth/roleRouting.test.js) — all 3 still failed on the clean baseline. No admin/riders suite is among the failures.
- `npm run build`: SUCCEEDED ("The build folder is ready to be deployed"; Compiled with warnings). All warnings are pre-existing eslint no-unused-vars / exhaustive-deps / BOM notices in unrelated files (App.js, AdminDashboard.js, etc.); none reference ridersApi.js or RiderDetailsDrawer.js.

ENVIRONMENT NOTE (LOCAL, repo-safe — NOT committed): the worktree had no frontend/node_modules; dependencies were populated by copying the main checkout's node_modules (identical package-lock hash). Two local patches were applied ONLY inside node_modules/react-scripts (untracked, gitignored) to work around a jest 27 / Windows bug: an absolute `<rootDir>` testMatch glob whose path contains the ".worktrees" segment is mangled by jest-util replacePathSepForGlob (it leaves "\.worktrees" so the compiled matcher drops the separator and matches 0 test files). Fix: createJestConfig.js now builds testMatch as absolute FORWARD-SLASH globs from a normalized rootDir, and test.js passes a forward-slashed rootDir. These patches live only in node_modules and affect neither the repo nor any commit; without them react-scripts finds 0 tests in this worktree path.
